preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, str) and len(c) == 1 for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The result is a list of single-character strings.
Each character appears at most once in the result.
Every character in the result appears at least twice in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the result is present in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(s.count(c) >= 2 for c in s if c in return_value) and all(c not in return_value for c in s if s.count(c) < 2)
postconditions.description: The result contains exactly those characters that appear at least twice in the input.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.index(c1) < return_value.index(c2) if (next((i for i, ch in enumerate(s) if ch == c1 and s.count(ch, 0, i+1) >= 2), float('inf')) < next((i for i, ch in enumerate(s) if ch == c2 and s.count(ch, 0, i+1) >= 2), float('inf'))) else True for i1, c1 in enumerate(return_value) for i2, c2 in enumerate(return_value) if i1 < i2)
postconditions.description: Characters in the result are ordered by the index of their first repetition (the second occurrence of the character in the string).
